# durantic_route (Resource)

Route resource for Durantic network routing

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Minimal example — only required fields, all defaults apply
resource "durantic_route" "minimal" {
  name     = "internal-route"
  prefixes = ["10.0.0.0/8"]
}

# Full example with all optional fields configured
resource "durantic_route" "example" {
  name     = "prod-route"
  enabled  = true
  prefixes = ["10.0.0.0/8", "192.168.0.0/16"]

  machine_uuids = [
    "a8ecf9c8-1721-424d-ba0f-87917dfc03d8",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the route
- `prefixes` (List of String) Network prefixes for this route (at least one required)

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the route is enabled
- `machine_uuids` (List of String) UUIDs of machines to associate with this route

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the route was created
- `machine_count` (Number) Number of machines associated with this route
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the route was last updated
- `uuid` (String) Unique identifier for the route

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

terraform import durantic_route.example "a8ecf9c8-1721-424d-ba0f-87917dfc03d8"
```
